title: Ordinary normalized braided tensor restriction to a clopen pro-etale component
statement: Let X and Y be schemes and j : Y → X both an open and a closed immersion. Let R be a sheaf of commutative rings on the pro-etale site of X, in the coefficient universe of def-pur-clopen-total-tensor-data. The actual sectionwise module restriction along j has a strong braided monoidal structure h for the existing sheaf tensors. Its inverse tensorator sends the restricted canonical sheafified pure tensor x tensor y to the canonical pure tensor of the restricted sections, for every pair of R-module sheaves, every test object U of Y.ProEt and all sections x,y over jU. No total complexes are involved.

source.place: Tag 03EL, lemma-tensor-product-pullback; Tag 0GMW, lemma-sheafification-tensor. The unit-compatible restriction comparison is Sites Tag 04B8.

proof.text: Apply exists_unique_ringedPushforward_laxMonoidal to composition along j with the identity map of the restricted ring sheaf. This gives a lax monoidal structure on the actual sectionwise module restriction and the forward pure-tensor normalization, with unit equal to the identity on ring sections. The site and coefficient universes remain independent.

The sectionwise identity identifies the tensor of the restricted underlying module presheaves with the restriction of their tensor. Let a be the sheafification unit followed by tensorObjIsoSheafification.inv on the component. The normalization says that a followed by the lax tensorator is this identity followed by the restriction of the original sheafification unit and tensorObjIsoSheafification.inv. Both a and that composite are local bijections: units and isomorphisms are, and the composition functor is cocontinuous. Cancellation of local equivalences shows the tensorator is locally bijective, hence an isomorphism between sheaves. The unit isomorphism is sectionwise the identity. Monoidal.ofLaxMonoidal gives the strong monoidal structure without changing any tensor or restriction object.

Morphisms from a sheaf tensor are determined by pure tensors, by tensorObjIsoSheafification, the module sheafification adjunction and sectionwise tensor induction. Check the braided equation on those generators, using the forward normalization and moduleTmul_braiding on each site. This promotes the strong monoidal structure to a braided one. Finally apply the inverse tensorator to the forward pure-tensor normalization and cancel its composite with the tensorator. The resulting inverse normalization is exactly clopenTensorComparison on clopenTensorPure. All proofs apply to the empty component and the zero ring.

proof_origin.place: Tags 03D6, 03EK, 03EL and 0GMW; normalized lax direct image plus cocontinuous preservation of local bijections (Sites 04B8).

lean.statement:
theorem clopen_ordinary_tensor_normalization
    {X Y : Scheme.{t}} (j : Y ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j] [IsClosedImmersion j]
    (R : Sheaf (topology X) CommRingCat.{max u (t + 1)}) :
    ∃ h : (ClopenData.clopenTensorRestriction.{t, u} j R).Braided,
      ∀ (F H : ClopenData.clopenTensorModules.{t, u} R) (U : Y.ProEt)
        (x : F.val.obj (op ((MorphismProperty.Over.map ⊤
          (inferInstance : WeaklyEtale j)).obj U)))
        (y : H.val.obj (op ((MorphismProperty.Over.map ⊤
          (inferInstance : WeaklyEtale j)).obj U))),
        (ClopenData.clopenTensorComparison.{t, u} j R h F H).hom.val.app (op U)
          (ClopenData.clopenTensorPure.{t, u} R F H _ x y) =
        ClopenData.clopenTensorPure.{t, u} ((ClopenData.clopenTensorRings.{t, u} j).obj R)
          ((ClopenData.clopenTensorRestriction.{t, u} j R).obj F)
          ((ClopenData.clopenTensorRestriction.{t, u} j R).obj H) (op U) x y
